description: Baseline window/webview permissions for the main Sentinel window. Per Tauri v2 docs (security/capabilities), commands registered via invoke_handler are allowed for all windows by default — this only needs to grow for PLUGIN commands (fs, shell, etc.) a later phase might add, not for the app's own #[tauri::command] functions. Unverified against a real build yet (no toolchain when written) — if IPC calls start failing with a permission-denied error once this actually runs, this is the first file to check.
